items.title: Fire drill
items.text: The alarm will sound for real. Leave by the nearest exit and meet at the assembly point by the car park.

items.title: Clocks went back. Bike lights on.
items.text: It is dark by half past four now. Lights front and back on the way home, please.

items.title: Fika Friday
items.text: Cinnamon buns and coffee for everyone. Bring a mug.
items.imageAlt: A cup of coffee and a cinnamon bun

items.title: Last one out starts the dishwasher
items.text: Tablets are in the cupboard left of the sink. Empty it if it's clean.

items.title: Mårten Gås lunch
items.text: Black soup and goose, with a vegetarian option. Sign up by Monday 9 November.

items.title: Julbord
items.text: The Christmas dinner. Save the evening, invitation follows.
